name: Manifold Dual Contouring with Adaptive Grids
definition: A method for isosurface extraction that uses either k-d trees or octrees as adaptive data structures to perform error-controlled simplification while preserving topology via manifold vertex clustering and QEF minimization.
summary: Manifold Dual Contouring with Adaptive Grids is an isosurface extraction method using k-d trees or octrees to ensure two-manifold meshes via QEF minimization and vertex clustering.
